title: Preflight Decision Attestation
description: A signed, deterministic record that the INDEPENDENT verifier reached a decision for a specific (repo, commit, action, evidence, policy, verifier) tuple at a specific time. Produced only by the independent execution environment (which holds the signing key). Binds identity so it cannot be replayed onto a different commit/action/repo; tamper-evident via HMAC over the canonical payload (the object minus the attestation envelope).

repoId.description: Canonical repository identity (host/owner/repo) the decision is bound to.

commitSha.description: The 40-hex commit SHA the decision was made against.

actionDigest.description: Canonical sha256 of the Action Intent's action object.

evidenceDigest.description: The Evidence Bundle's bundleDigest (canonical sha256 over the bundle sans attestation).

issuedAt.description: RFC3339 UTC time the attestation was issued.

expiresAt.description: RFC3339 UTC time after which the attestation is stale (rejected).

runId.description: Identifier of the independent run that produced this (e.g. CI run id).

nonce.description: Unique per-issuance marker. v0.1 has no persistent nonce store (see threat model).

attestation.description: Integrity envelope over the canonical payload (this object minus this field).

payloadDigest.description: Declared canonical sha256 over the attestation sans envelope. Recomputed + compared by the verifier (tamper → mismatch).

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over payloadDigest under the independent-environment key. Symmetric (v0.1 boundary).
